name: ElasticPro client resources
author: ElasticPro
description: One row per client, as a table or as donuts of used, free and short: requested, allocated and used — servers, CPU, memory, disk — per family (ES, Parser, Forwarder, Engine …) or per role, ES storage, devices and log delay; each client expands into its servers. Every column customisable per widget or as report defaults: built-in figures, any Zabbix item key or two items calculated, now or average, minimum, maximum or change over a window, shown as a value, bar, coloured cell or text, indicators, sparkline or badge, with its own thresholds and colours or ElasticPro Settings and its palette. Needs attention, a Type filter, search, totals, CSV and Excel export with a Servers sheet.
